value.author: preset-feedback-rehearsal
value.text: Rehearsal feedback: clarify which parts of the shared store only read and which parts lock and publish changes; also distinguish HTML publication from model commit. This is a preset exercise, not user acceptance of the architecture.

value.responsibility: Read and validate complete models without writing; separately build candidates and commit one revision under a file lock using atomic replacement.
value.rationale: Shared model lifecycle warrants one logical store ID across both businesses. read/load_json validate without locking or writing; commit acquires FileLock and atomic_write uses os.replace. This responsibility boundary does not imply every read is a transaction.

Read-only consumer of one validated revision: projection derives maintenance and snippets without saving. export_html publishes with non-overwriting os.link, distinct from ModelStore atomic replacement. Browser interaction remains outside the Python extraction.

value.command: uv run python -m architecture_model model --file examples/architecture_model/codeboarding/model.json validate
value.environment: Windows 11; Python 3.12.13; repository venv; no provider or .env
value.inputs: Model ba06c25c-e8de-4781-8a09-e7643b9e4721, revision 3 before feedback; entire persisted JSON; structure/reference validation only, not business execution.
